column1: # Table S2. The composition, dispersion and maternal-identity analyses on all four distance metrics, and the treatment contrast within each litter.

# (a) Environment: PERMANOVA pseudo-F(1,24) and R2 for Clean vs Muck (n = 26), P exact from all 211680 within-litter treatment assignments. The last two columns are mean pairwise distances between siblings and between non-siblings. Dispersion: PERMDISP on distances to the group spatial median, 9,999 permutations (scripts/permdisp_validated.js). Dam: PERMANOVA with dam as a four-level factor, F(3,22), 9,999 permutations (smallest attainable P = 0.0001).

# (b) The same PERMANOVA inside each litter that received both treatments, P exact from every assignment within that litter (252, 56 and 15 assignments; smallest attainable P = 0.0079, 0.018 and 0.067). Values are R2 (P).
# (c) Alpha diversity: medians by treatment within each litter that received both treatments (rarefied to 5,000 reads).

# (d) Partition of the dam term into facility (1 df; dams 11.21 and 11.22 at one facility, NR1908 and NR1912 at the other) and dam within facility (2 df), on the same 26 animals and distance matrices. P for dam within facility from 9,999 permutations of labels within facility; P for facility from 9,999 free permutations (descriptive only, two dams per facility).
